lead_raw_text:
The structure of Y2Co6C crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 18 atoms (Y4Co12C2) distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows carbon centers coordinated by nine neighbors (Co and Y) and cobalt centers in two environments: octahedral coordination by six neighbors and a seven-neighbor environment. Y centers have 15 geometric neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include edge- and corner-sharing between Co octahedra and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between C-centered 9-vertex polyhedra.
